label: Law signed
detail: The 2025 budget reconciliation law (P.L. 119-21) becomes law. Section 71119 creates the Medicaid work rule.

label: Nebraska starts early
detail: Nebraska applies the rule to new enrollees, then at renewals from July 1, 2026.

label: CMS issues the rule
detail: CMS releases its interim final rule (CMS-2454-IFC), published in the Federal Register on June 3.

label: Rule takes effect
detail: The CMS rule takes effect and public comments close. The same day, a federal judge denies the states' request to pause it.

label: Court strikes extra frailty test
detail: In Massachusetts v. Oz, a federal court in Massachusetts throws out the CMS add-on that made people in a medically frail group also prove the condition limits their ability to work. CMS says it will appeal.

label: Four states sue
detail: Oregon, Minnesota, New Mexico and Washington sue in federal court in Oregon, arguing states cannot be forced to run the rule.

label: CMS offers a 6 month grace period
detail: States may keep checking but stop cutting people off for this rule through June 30, 2027.

label: New York opts in
detail: New York says it will use the grace period.

label: States tell CMS
detail: CMS asks states that want the grace period from January 1 to tell it by this date.

label: Rule starts
detail: Every state that has to run the rule must have it in place by now.

label: Grace period ends
detail: Last day of the optional grace period. After this, people found out of compliance can be denied or cut off.

label: Latest state exemption ends
detail: The latest a good faith exemption for a struggling state can last, if HHS approves one.
